_comment: The exhausted-retry stall notice of implement.yml pinned from main 6f04355 (post spec 040, 2026-08-24 merge). Pinned as CONTENT because CI checkouts are shallow, so a git-ref baseline is unreadable there. If main rewords these steps again, regenerate this file deliberately, in its own reviewed change. #598 moved the scratch paths from a fixed /tmp file to $RUNNER_TEMP; the notice's wording is unchanged. specs/071-agent-push-credential: 'Report stalled on lifecycle issue' moved out of this byte-pinned fixture (it now renders a conditional 'commits published' line) -- verify-implement-stall-notice-unchanged.py checks it behaviorally instead, the same way it already checks 'Determine which dependency did not start'.

Mark lifecycle record stalled.run:
jq '.stage = "stalled"' "$SPEC_DIR/spec-meta.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/meta.json"
mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/meta.json" "$SPEC_DIR/spec-meta.json"
git config user.name  "${BOT_SLUG}[bot]"
git config user.email "${BOT_SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git add "$SPEC_DIR/spec-meta.json"
# A restarted iteration that fails again finds the record already
# stalled; committing nothing must not kill the job before the
# issue report below runs.
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "spec-meta.json already reads stage=stalled — nothing to commit." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
else
  git commit -m "implement: mark $SLUG stalled (iteration $ITERATION failed)"
  git push
fi
